title: Effectiveness of RSVpreF vaccination in adults 60+ during the 2023–24 season
abstract: Retrospective test-negative study across 12 US systems estimating RSVpreF effectiveness against medically attended RSV in adults ≥60 years.
author_corresponding_institution: Kaiser Permanente Vaccine Study Center

title: Long COVID symptom clusters and functional impact in a population-based cohort
abstract: Latent class analysis identified four persistent symptom clusters; cognitive and cardiopulmonary clusters were associated with the largest work impairment.
author_corresponding_institution: University of Manchester, Division of Population Health

title: Clinical performance of a saliva RT-LAMP assay for influenza A/B in urgent care
abstract: Prospective evaluation of saliva RT-LAMP compared with RT-qPCR; sensitivity was highest within 72 hours of symptom onset.
author_corresponding_institution: UCSF Department of Laboratory Medicine

title: Trends in antibiotic prescribing after virtual visits for acute respiratory infections
abstract: Interrupted time-series analysis shows a decline in broad-spectrum prescribing after guideline-aligned order sets were introduced in telehealth clinics.
author_corresponding_institution: Mayo Clinic, Division of Infectious Diseases

title: Neutralizing antibody responses after XBB.1.5 booster in immunocompromised adults
abstract: In a multicenter cohort, neutralization titers rose modestly in solid-organ transplant recipients and were strongly associated with prior infection.
author_corresponding_institution: Imperial College London, Department of Infectious Disease

title: Association of GLP-1 receptor agonist use with incident atrial fibrillation in type 2 diabetes
abstract: New-user cohort study using claims data found lower atrial fibrillation incidence among GLP-1RA initiators versus DPP-4 inhibitors after weighting.
author_corresponding_institution: University of Washington, Department of Epidemiology

title: Early warning scores for sepsis in the emergency department: external validation across three sites
abstract: NEWS2 and qSOFA were compared in 178,000 ED visits; calibration varied by site and improved after local recalibration.
author_corresponding_institution: University of Edinburgh, Usher Institute

title: Causal effects of air pollution on preterm birth using a negative control exposure design
abstract: Daily PM2.5 exposure during gestation was linked to modestly higher preterm risk; negative control analyses reduced evidence for residual confounding.
author_corresponding_institution: London School of Hygiene & Tropical Medicine

title: Household transmission of SARS-CoV-2 in the Omicron era: a prospective study
abstract: Secondary attack rates were higher in households with young children; prior infection reduced risk more than vaccination alone in this cohort.
author_corresponding_institution: Emory University, Rollins School of Public Health

title: Safety signals after mpox vaccination: analysis of VAERS reports from 2022–2024
abstract: Disproportionality analysis found no new serious safety signals; myocarditis reporting was rare and similar to background expectations.
author_corresponding_institution: CDC, Immunization Safety Office

title: Seroprevalence of SARS-CoV-2 antibodies in blood donors in northern Italy
abstract: Cross-sectional serosurvey of repeat donors estimated cumulative incidence and highlighted higher seroprevalence in urban areas after the first wave.
author_corresponding_institution: Fondazione IRCCS Ca' Granda Ospedale Maggiore Policlinico

title: Evaluating AI-assisted triage notes in urgent care: a randomized, clinician-blinded trial
abstract: AI-suggested triage summaries reduced documentation time and improved completeness without increasing safety events over 4 weeks.
author_corresponding_institution: Mass General Brigham, Digital Innovation Hub

title: Incidence and outcomes of pediatric myocarditis after mRNA COVID-19 vaccination in Canada
abstract: Linkage of provincial registries identified rare myocarditis cases; most had short hospital stays and no ICU requirement.
author_corresponding_institution: University of Toronto, Dalla Lana School of Public Health

title: Cognitive outcomes after ICU delirium: a 12-month prospective follow-up study
abstract: Among 412 ICU survivors, delirium duration was associated with worse executive function at 12 months after adjustment for illness severity.
author_corresponding_institution: Vanderbilt University Medical Center, Division of Pulmonary and Critical Care

title: Metagenomic sequencing for bloodstream infection: diagnostic yield and turnaround in routine practice
abstract: Shotgun metagenomics increased pathogen detection in culture-negative sepsis; median time-to-result was 33 hours with an on-call workflow.
author_corresponding_institution: University College London Hospitals NHS Foundation Trust

title: Equity impacts of home blood pressure monitoring programs in primary care
abstract: Program enrollment was lower in patients with limited English proficiency; providing multilingual onboarding narrowed gaps in sustained use.
author_corresponding_institution: NYU Langone Health, Department of Population Health

title: Clinical utility of polygenic risk scores for coronary artery disease in South Asian adults
abstract: Polygenic scores improved discrimination modestly beyond conventional risk factors; calibration differed across ancestry subgroups and required recalibration.
author_corresponding_institution: All India Institute of Medical Sciences, New Delhi

title: Wastewater surveillance for norovirus: correlates with emergency visits in five cities
abstract: Norovirus RNA concentrations in wastewater tracked ED gastroenteritis visits with a 7–10 day lead time across sites.
author_corresponding_institution: Barcelona Institute for Global Health (ISGlobal)

title: Screening mammography backlog after COVID-19 disruptions: modeling recovery strategies
abstract: Simulation suggests extended clinic hours and targeted reminders could reduce backlog faster than increasing machine capacity alone.
author_corresponding_institution: Dana-Farber Cancer Institute, Department of Population Sciences

title: Real-world glycemic outcomes after switching to automated insulin delivery in adults with type 1 diabetes
abstract: Continuous glucose monitor data showed increased time-in-range and fewer hypoglycemia episodes after transition to hybrid closed-loop systems.
author_corresponding_institution: Joslin Diabetes Center, Harvard Medical School

title: Predicting hospital readmission using multimodal EHR embeddings: a multi-site study
abstract: A transformer model combining labs, medications, and notes improved AUROC modestly over gradient boosting; performance degraded with missingness.
author_corresponding_institution: University of Michigan, Department of Computational Medicine

title: Maternal RSV vaccination and infant hospitalization: emulation of a target trial
abstract: Using linked EHR and birth records, maternal RSV vaccination was associated with fewer RSV hospitalizations in infants under 6 months.
author_corresponding_institution: University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill, Gillings School of Global Public Health

title: A pragmatic trial of text-message nudges to improve statin adherence after MI
abstract: Two-way SMS reminders increased days covered by statins by 6 percentage points at 6 months; effects were larger in patients under 65.
author_corresponding_institution: University of Glasgow, Institute of Cardiovascular and Medical Sciences

title: Clostridioides difficile recurrence after bezlotoxumab: real-world outcomes in three hospitals
abstract: Recurrence within 12 weeks was lower in patients receiving bezlotoxumab alongside standard therapy, particularly in those with prior episodes.
author_corresponding_institution: University Hospitals Birmingham NHS Foundation Trust

title: Chat-based mental health support for university students: observational study of engagement and outcomes
abstract: Higher message volume and earlier follow-up were associated with larger symptom score reductions; dropout was most common after week two.
author_corresponding_institution: King's College London, Institute of Psychiatry, Psychology & Neuroscience

title: A multi-ancestry GWAS of migraine identifies novel loci and drug targets
abstract: Meta-analysis across biobanks identified new migraine loci and prioritized genes enriched in trigeminal pathways; Mendelian randomization suggested lipid links.
author_corresponding_institution: RIKEN Center for Integrative Medical Sciences

title: Comparative effectiveness of Paxlovid in vaccinated adults: emulation using EHR data
abstract: In vaccinated adults at elevated risk, Paxlovid use was associated with reduced hospitalization; benefit was smaller in those under 50.
author_corresponding_institution: Kaiser Permanente Northern California, Division of Research

title: Blood-based proteomic signature predicts progression in early Parkinson’s disease
abstract: A 19-protein panel predicted motor progression over 24 months and replicated in an independent cohort; inflammatory proteins were most informative.
author_corresponding_institution: Karolinska Institutet, Department of Neurobiology, Care Sciences and Society

title: Preoperative anemia and postoperative delirium in older adults undergoing hip fracture surgery
abstract: In a multicenter registry, anemia was associated with higher delirium risk; transfusion was not independently protective after adjustment.
author_corresponding_institution: Charité – Universitätsmedizin Berlin, Department of Anesthesiology

title: Home spirometry monitoring in interstitial lung disease: adherence and data quality in a remote program
abstract: Adherence declined after 8 weeks but stabilized with automated reminders; device drift was detectable and correctable using weekly calibration prompts.
author_corresponding_institution: National Jewish Health, Division of Pulmonary Sciences

title: Mortality after extreme heat exposure in older adults: a case-crossover study in England
abstract: Heat exposure above local thresholds was associated with increased short-term mortality, especially in areas with low green space.
author_corresponding_institution: UK Health Security Agency, Environmental Hazards and Emergencies

title: Accuracy of smartwatch atrial fibrillation detection in older adults with frequent ectopy
abstract: In ambulatory monitoring, false positives were driven by PAC/PVC burden; algorithm updates reduced misclassification but did not eliminate it.
author_corresponding_institution: University of Colorado Anschutz Medical Campus, Division of Cardiology

title: Prevalence of hazardous alcohol use among healthcare workers after the pandemic peak
abstract: Anonymous survey found elevated AUDIT-C scores in ICU staff; work hours and sleep disruption were the strongest correlates.
author_corresponding_institution: University of Bristol, Population Health Sciences

title: Validation of a bilingual depression screener in primary care clinics serving migrants
abstract: A short bilingual screener showed good sensitivity versus clinician diagnosis; optimal cutoffs differed slightly between Spanish and Arabic forms.
author_corresponding_institution: UCLA Department of Family Medicine

title: Single-cell atlas of human airway epithelium after RSV infection reveals interferon-resistant states
abstract: scRNA-seq of infected airway cultures identified a rare epithelial state with low ISG induction and higher viral RNA; CRISPRi implicated IRF9 suppression.
author_corresponding_institution: Max Planck Institute for Infection Biology

title: Clinical severity of H5N1 infection in dairy farm workers: a rapid assessment
abstract: Among exposed workers with conjunctivitis or mild respiratory symptoms, most had self-limited illness; no hospitalizations were reported.
author_corresponding_institution: Michigan Department of Health and Human Services

title: Persistence of SARS-CoV-2 RNA in wastewater solids predicts local outbreaks during 2022
abstract: Wastewater solids measurements correlated with case rates across counties; lead time varied by testing access and reporting delays.
author_corresponding_institution: Syracuse University, Public Health

title: Prevalence of undiagnosed CKD using cystatin C in community screening events
abstract: Adding cystatin C reclassified 9% of participants to a higher CKD stage; reclassification was more common in older adults and women.
author_corresponding_institution: Johns Hopkins Bloomberg School of Public Health

title: Efficacy of a digital CBT program for insomnia in shift workers: a cluster randomized trial
abstract: Digital CBT-I improved ISI scores and sleep efficiency among hospital shift workers; benefits persisted at 3 months with high app adherence.
author_corresponding_institution: Monash University, School of Psychological Sciences

title: Post-acute sequelae of COVID-19 in children: a matched cohort study
abstract: Children with prior SARS-CoV-2 infection had higher rates of fatigue and headache diagnoses over 6 months versus matched controls.
author_corresponding_institution: Children's Hospital of Philadelphia, Center for Pediatric Clinical Effectiveness

title: Hospital-onset candidemia risk factors in patients receiving parenteral nutrition
abstract: Central line days and broad-spectrum antibiotics were the strongest predictors; an EHR-based alert improved time-to-antifungal therapy.
author_corresponding_institution: Rush University Medical Center, Division of Infectious Diseases

title: A rapid systematic review of Mpox transmission in household and healthcare settings
abstract: Evidence supports limited household transmission with close contact; healthcare-associated transmission was rare with PPE and isolation protocols.
author_corresponding_institution: University of Zurich, Institute of Public Health
